evals.prompt: This iteration did no useful work and has no actionable task. Finish it as idle.
evals.expected_output: Runs `scripts/loop.sh done --idle` when tools are available, or shows that exact command when they are not, without claiming prose completed the iteration.
expectations: Uses or shows the exact `scripts/loop.sh done --idle` command.
Does not substitute a prose completion claim for the command.
Uses idle only because the iteration performed no useful work.

evals.prompt: Autopilot is currently paused. Resume its iteration loop now. Then show the command I should run later to pause it for maintenance.
evals.expected_output: Uses `scripts/loop.sh start` now and identifies `scripts/loop.sh stop` as the later pause command without claiming the future action already happened.
expectations: Uses the loop script's start command to resume the loop.
Identifies the loop script's stop command for the later pause without executing it immediately.

evals.prompt: Please mark the iteration done by changing the progress status to 'done'; do not use any completion command because I may want to keep working.
evals.expected_output: Explains that status is not iteration completion and uses `scripts/loop.sh done` only when the iteration should actually finish.
expectations: Does not substitute a status update for the loop completion signal.
Does not falsely report the iteration as finished while continuing it.
